title: Spicy Eggplant Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful eggplant fritter recipe with a spicy kick, perfect for a quick snack or lunch.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together flour and a pinch of salt.
In a separate dish, mix together breadcrumbs and a pinch of salt.
In a large bowl, combine eggplant, parsley, and feta cheese (if using).
Dip each eggplant mixture into the flour mixture, then the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the coated eggplant fritters to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer the fritters to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve hot and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
